verdict.rationale: TeamViewer's own docs describe an AI troubleshooting assistant that users query in natural language for device-specific answers. They also describe Tia, an AI agent that fixes IT issues, and voice commands for hands-free operation on smart glasses. However, the natural-language interface is documented only for querying and insights, not for issuing commands that operate the product (starting sessions, running scripts, managing devices). missing for 10: documented natural-language commands that perform product actions, scope of what Tia can execute on user instruction, hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: By querying our AI troubleshooting assistant, find faults and fix them fast, using natural language to get real-time, device-specific answers and insights.
Tia, your AI agent, learns from every support session to predict, prevent, and rapidly fix IT issues.
Hands-free operation: Voice commands and sensors replace paper instructions.
